newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Paneuropean buys stake in Liberty.
newsitem.headline: Paneuropean buys stake in Liberty.

text.p: The Paneuropean Insurance Group on Monday announced it had purchased more than 25 percent of capital in Liberty Life Insurance.
A company announcement on the Cyprus Stock Exchange (CSE) said Euroinvestment and Finance, a member of the Paneuropean Group, purchased 262,740 shares in Liberty Life at 95 cents per share.
The Paneuropean Group reserves options for the further purchase of shares in Liberty Life, the announcement said.
The CSE halted transactions in Paneuropean and Liberty Life on Monday as part of a standard procedure to review the deal.
